intro: Tunisia has about 12 million people, most of them living near the coast.

chapters.title: People
text: Tunisians speak Arabic, and French is widely used. Most are Sunni Muslim; Djerba has one of the oldest Jewish communities in the world. Education levels are high, and many women go to university.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Tunis, the capital, has an old medina and the ruins of Carthage nearby.
